scope: Corollary 3.2 of the manuscript “An FPRAS for Cell-Bounded Contingency Tables” (preprints/An-FPRAS-for-Cell-Bounded-Contingency-Tables-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 115 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 10bad4277d11b9d1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For 0 ≤ j ≤ H, the matrix of two-removal weights of hj at every box-valid display of total p + 2 has at most one positive eigenvalue. The corresponding two-addition matrix at every box-valid display of total p − 2 has the same property.
